checkpointProof.qualification: Seven comparisons bind the cold original owner state, exact complete selected proposal, acquired event, retained source fact, exact command/observation/outcome transition and source cursor. The final check also requires the actual synchronous native restore after that record: exact received envelope, successful completion outside any source call, and equality of its resulting source state with the live instance at prefix capture and the independently reconstructed original. Increasing restore indices and the two captured cursors establish record then restore then capture, including a terminal prefix without a later proposal. An asynchronous restore is observed without changing its return but cannot qualify this synchronous runtime contract. No extra native restoration or state injection is performed. Only selected Symbols prefixes and exported source fields are covered; foreign-prefix conservation and private caches are not asserted. Missing legacy checkpoint or restoration captures are not counted as this proof.
